fills.researcher_notes: This is the row the brief flagged as the strongest lead (P4138 feeds Nandipur Power Plant, a heavily-reported public project). Multiple independent outlets place the pipeline's completion/first gas at April 2017: Wikipedia's Nandipur Power Project article states the plant 'started a 525 MW test run on regasified liquefied natural gas (RLNG) with 30 million cubic feet per day of gas supply from Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited (SNGPL)' on 23 April 2017; naturalgasworld.com (25 Apr 2017, 'Pakistani Nandipur power plant will now run on gas') and The Nation (23 Apr 2017, 'Nandipur Plant converted to LNG') corroborate the same April 2017 conversion/first-gas date. The EPC contractor, Gasco Engineering, independently confirms a 24-inch pipeline + 165 MMscfd fuel gas boosting station project for NPGCL/Nandipur executed in 2017 over a 16-month duration (gascoengineering.com.pk/pf/nandipur/ and /pf/npgcl/ — same project, two listing pages, both confirm diameter=24in matching the sheet's Diameter=24 and completion year 2017). Four independent origins (Wikipedia, a trade-press outlet, a national newspaper, and the contractor's own project page) agree on 2017 as the year gas began flowing to Nandipur via this pipeline, so StartYear1=2017 at high confidence. Caveat for a human, not a fill: NS Energy Business and Daily Parliament Times (both syndicating the same April 2017 story) describe an '88km' pipeline, versus this row's LengthKnown=76.4 km -- close but not identical, and outside this row's flagged question (Date_logic only), so I did not open a length_ratio finding; flagging in case another leg wants to check whether the 88km figure covers a different segment set. FIFTH corroborating angle found independently: SNGPL's OWN annual reports (AR2018 and AR2019, identical milestone-timeline graphic in both) place 'PROJECT X (PHASE IV): 30/24in dia x 149 km long spurs...for supply of RLNG to Power Plants i.e. Bhikki, Balloki, Haveli Bahadur Shah and Nandipur' at years 2015-2017 -- naming this exact facility by target plant and matching the 2017 date. https://www.sngpl.com.pk/download/AnnualReport-2019/SNGPLAR2019.pdf

validity.recommendation: No action on Diameter/LengthKnown -- both are corroborated exactly against SNGPL's own asset register, and the pipeline's existence-by-June-2018 timing is independently consistent with the 2017 StartYear1 fill above (not a later FY2018-19 build, ruling out an alternative reading of the AR2019 narrative text).
validity.researcher_notes: LOUD FLAG for the whole cluster (identical note repeated on every row in this brief -- this is the highest-value find the brief asked for): SNGPL Annual Report 2018, pages 32-35 ('TRANSMISSION SYSTEM As at June 30, 2018', https://www.sngpl.com.pk/download/AnnualReport-2018/SNGPLAR-2018.pdf) is a text-searchable, per-segment listing of the ENTIRE SNGPL transmission network (Sr.No / SECTION / DIA / MAINLINE km / LOOPLINE km) -- exactly the engineering-document class the brief's 'MP 59.91' milepost lead was hoping to surface. Row 129 reads 'MP 59.91 - NANDIPUR POWER PLANT / 24in / mainline 76.4 km' -- an EXACT match to this row's Diameter and LengthKnown -- and its presence in the 'as at June 30, 2018' snapshot confirms the asset already existed by mid-2018, corroborating (not contradicting) the 2017 completion date above. One ambiguity worth flagging: AR2019's narrative text separately lists 'Spur pipeline works for supplying 100 MMCFD gas to RLNG based Nandipur power plant' among a cumulative multi-year list of achievements under the Company's broader 1200 MMCFD RLNG-import augmentation program -- read in isolation this COULD look like a FY2018-19 claim, but the register (asset already present as of June 2018) and the milestone-timeline graphic (Phase IV dated 2015-2017 in both AR2018 and AR2019, unchanged) both fix it to 2017; I did not let the ambiguous narrative sentence override the two dated/registered sources.
